summary_ja: 2026年の新規一次情報として、NVIDIA Spectrum-6/ConnectX-9とAMD HeliosのSalina DPU、UALoE、Vulcano 800を追加しました。front-end、scale-up、scale-out、optics、冷却、管理softwareを一体で比較し、aggregate帯域、公表性能、初期採用、一般提供、実測を区別します。単一モデルによる暫定調査で、Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: This update adds new 2026 primary-source information on NVIDIA Spectrum-6 and ConnectX-9 and AMD Helios with Salina DPU, UALoE, and Vulcano 800. It compares front-end, scale-up, scale-out, optics, cooling, and management software together while separating aggregate bandwidth, vendor claims, early adoption, general availability, and measurements. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

sections.title_en: Front-end, scale-up, and scale-out networks for 2026 AI infrastructure
sections.summary_ja: NVIDIA Spectrum-6とAMD Heliosのnetwork構成を、接続階層、公開仕様、運用機能、実証不足に分けて整理します。
sections.summary_en: Organize NVIDIA Spectrum-6 and AMD Helios networking by connectivity tier, published specifications, operational functions, and missing independent evidence.

items.name_en: Scale-out Ethernet with Spectrum-6 and ConnectX-9
items.timing_ja: 2026年7月発表、初期導入事業者を公表
items.timing_en: Announced July 2026 with initial infrastructure adopters named
items.statement_ja: NVIDIAはSpectrum-6を102.4 Tb/sのEthernet switch systemとして公表し、ConnectX-9 SuperNICと組み合わせた次世代Spectrum-XをVera Rubinのscale-out fabricに位置付けました。pluggable opticsとco-packaged opticsの両方、液冷、open network OS、複数のRDMA transportを支援するとしています。CoreWeave、Microsoft、Nebius、OCI等を初期導入事業者として挙げていますが、個別の稼働開始日、構成規模、可用性、第三者測定は示されていません。最大95%のnetwork efficiencyや既製Ethernet比最大1.6倍はNVIDIA公表値であり、HPCIのMPI・I/O混在負荷へ直接適用しません。
items.statement_en: NVIDIA describes Spectrum-6 as a 102.4 Tb/s Ethernet switch system and pairs it with ConnectX-9 SuperNICs as the next Spectrum-X scale-out fabric for Vera Rubin. It supports pluggable and co-packaged optics, liquid cooling, open network operating systems, and a choice of RDMA transports. CoreWeave, Microsoft, Nebius, OCI, and others are named as early adopters, but deployment dates, installed scale, availability, and third-party measurements are not given. Claims of up to 95% network efficiency and up to 1.6x performance over off-the-shelf Ethernet are NVIDIA figures and are not transferred directly to HPCI MPI and mixed-I/O workloads.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCIの次期network候補はport速度だけでなく、optics方式、冷却、RDMA実装、障害迂回、network OS、vendor lock-inを一体で比較する必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Future HPCI networks should compare optics, cooling, RDMA implementation, failure bypass, network operating systems, and vendor dependence together rather than port speed alone.
adoption_conditions_ja: 出荷・一般提供・国内保守の時期と構成別価格を確認する。
MPI、GPU collective、storage I/Oの混在時に実効帯域、p99 latency、公平性、障害回復を測定する。
pluggable opticsとCPOについて電力、故障単位、交換時間、予備品を比較する。
adoption_conditions_en: Confirm shipment, general availability, domestic support, and configuration pricing.
Measure delivered bandwidth, p99 latency, fairness, and recovery under mixed MPI, GPU-collective, and storage-I/O traffic.
Compare power, failure domains, replacement time, and spares for pluggable optics and CPO.

items.name_en: Three-tier front-end, scale-up, and scale-out networking in AMD Helios
items.statement_ja: AMDはHeliosのnetworkを、Salina DPUによるfront-end、UALoEによるscale-up、Vulcano 800 AI NICによるscale-out/scale-acrossの三層として提示しました。scale-upは72基のMI455Xをsingle-hopで接続し、aggregate 260 TB/sと31 TBのHBM4、18の独立UALoE station、Fabric Manager/Fabric OS、分割可能なvPodを公表しています。Vulcano 800はGPU当たり最大2.4 Tb/sのscale-out帯域としています。これらはrack aggregate値またはAMD公表値であり、個々のGPU pairの専有帯域、一般提供、異種vendor相互運用、実applicationの性能を意味しません。
items.statement_en: AMD presents Helios networking as three tiers: a Salina DPU front end, UALoE scale-up, and Vulcano 800 AI NIC scale-out and scale-across. The scale-up design connects 72 MI455X GPUs in a single hop and publishes 260 TB/s aggregate bandwidth, 31 TB of HBM4, 18 independent UALoE stations, Fabric Manager and Fabric OS, and partitionable vPods. Vulcano 800 is specified for up to 2.4 Tb/s of scale-out bandwidth per GPU. These are rack-aggregate or AMD-reported figures and do not establish bandwidth exclusively available to each GPU pair, general availability, heterogeneous-vendor interoperability, or application performance.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 三層networkと管理softwareを別々の部品ではなく一つのsystem architectureとして受入評価し、open standardの表明と実際の相互運用性を分ける必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: The three network tiers and management software should be accepted as one system architecture, while claims of open standards must be separated from demonstrated interoperability.
adoption_conditions_ja: Salina、UALoE、Vulcano 800の製品提供時期、switch構成、国内保守を確認する。
UALink/UEC準拠範囲と他vendorのNIC・switch・acceleratorとの相互運用を検証する。
vPod分割時の性能隔離、障害継続、telemetry、software upgradeを測定する。
adoption_conditions_en: Confirm product timing, switch configurations, and domestic support for Salina, UALoE, and Vulcano 800.
Verify UALink and UEC conformance scope and interoperability with other vendors' NICs, switches, and accelerators.
Measure performance isolation, failure continuity, telemetry, and software upgrades under vPod partitioning.
